cases.translation: Jehoash son of Jehoahaz began to reign.
cases.explain: The noun stands as part of the identification.

cases.sentence: И война между Израилем и Иудеей ___.
cases.translation: And war continued between Israel and Judah.
cases.explain: The verb продолжалась governs the instrumental case.
The noun stands in nominative after the adjective.

cases.sentence: Как он боролся и ___ одержал он над ним.
cases.translation: How he fought and won the battle over him.
cases.explain: The transitive verb одержал takes the accusative case.
The noun in possessive construction takes the genitive case.
The noun stands as the subject of поколебалась.

cases.translation: At the end of his life, Joash repented.
cases.explain: The preposition по (at) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Похоронили его в ___, где находилась могила царей.
cases.translation: They buried him in the tomb where the tombs of the kings were.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location meaning governs the prepositional case.
